criteria.criterion: Produces five Arabic poetic lines about the supplied key/coat/move situation
criteria.evidence: Five Arabic lines describe the old key left in a coat pocket after the move to a new house.

criteria.criterion: Honors prose form without a claimed classical meter
criteria.evidence: The everyday prose sentences make no claim to a classical meter.

criteria.criterion: Delivers the poem directly without forced tashkeel approval, editor setup, or commentary
criteria.evidence: The response delivers only the five poem lines. The trace has no approval step, editor setup or commentary.

criteria.criterion: Grounds interpretation in chair/door/repeated dust or equivalent supplied details
criteria.evidence: The answer grounds its interpretation in the chair facing the door, the repeated evening and the dust left by another day.

criteria.criterion: Does not infer death or author biography as fact
criteria.evidence: Death is explicitly an interpretive possibility rather than a fact; travel or broken contact remain possible.

criteria.criterion: Does not rewrite the supplied text or force meter analysis
criteria.evidence: The supplied image is explained without rewriting its words or checking meter.

criteria.criterion: Names tawil with a compact sound-to-foot account covering a complete hemistich
criteria.evidence: Tawil is named with all four feet of the first hemistich: قِفَا نَبْ, كِ مِنْ ذِكْرَى, حَبِيبِنْ, وَمَنْزِلِي. Each pronounced group has its short/long syllables and foot.

criteria.criterion: Distinguishes lam as rawi from final kasra/possible isba vowel
criteria.evidence: Lam is identified as rawi; the final lengthened kasra is pronounced ī and identified separately as wasl.

criteria.criterion: Answers in English and respects chat-only scope
criteria.evidence: The answer is English, remains in chat and does not open an editor.

criteria.criterion: Separates executed tool evidence from interpretation; never invents a run or treats arithmetic alone as proof
criteria.evidence: The actual scan.py verify --meter tawil command succeeds on both supplied hemistichs. The answer states connected recitation and lengthened final kasra rather than relying on arithmetic.

criteria.criterion: Keeps unvocalized and short-fragment uncertainty visible; does not claim a uniquely established whole-poem meter
criteria.evidence: Sari is proposed provisionally for this fragment; the response explicitly says it cannot establish the whole poem meter.

criteria.criterion: Keeps supplied text separate from any assumed vocalization
criteria.evidence: The assumed يَا قَلْبُ لَا تَسْأَلْ عَنِ الْغَائِبِينْ and pause are displayed separately from the supplied unvocalized words.

criteria.criterion: Provides useful brief preliminary reasoning or candidates without requiring an unnecessary confirmation turn
criteria.evidence: The response gives three sound-to-foot groups and a short explanation, supported by actual local weigh/verify commands, without demanding confirmation.

criteria.criterion: Preserves all base letters, spacing, negation and supplied marks
criteria.evidence: The proposed لَمْ أَبِعِ الْوَعْدَ وَلَمْ أَنْسَ وَجْهَكَ preserves base letters, spaces, both negations and every supplied mark.

criteria.criterion: Marks any consequential reading choice rather than silently changing intent
criteria.evidence: The response explicitly says وَجْهَكَ is read as addressing a male.

criteria.criterion: Stops for requested review without scanning or asserting a metrical verdict
criteria.evidence: The response ends أنتظر موافقتك. No scan or metrical verdict follows.

criteria.criterion: Preserves the four required words and performs a minimal viable change
criteria.evidence: The answer deletes only جِدًّا; all four required words, their order and supplied vocalization remain.

criteria.criterion: Discloses any lost emphasis or other semantic change
criteria.evidence: The answer explicitly explains that deleting جِدًّا removes emphasis on the degree of distance while retaining the underlying near-friend/distant-place meaning.

criteria.criterion: Demonstrates the added sound material before and four full faulun feet after, using actual available checking when claiming a run
criteria.evidence: Actual scan.py verify/analyze commands check the original and repaired readings. The answer shows the two excess long syllables from جِدْدَنْ before and four complete فعولن feet after.

criteria.criterion: Does not demand approval of already confirmed supplied vocalization
criteria.evidence: The supplied vocalization is accepted without a new approval question.

criteria.criterion: Preserves pronounced tanwin nun at the boundary
criteria.evidence: The response uses يَدُنْ تَاهَتْ and explicitly counts the pronounced tanwin nun in the long دُنْ syllable across the printed line boundary.

criteria.criterion: Does not certify the supplied connected reading as sound Kamil
criteria.evidence: The complete ب − − − reading is rejected as sound Kamil; the actual local scanner command does not match Kamil.

criteria.criterion: Does not classify the text as prose poetry merely because a supported meter fails
criteria.evidence: The response draws no prose-poetry classification from the failed metrical match.

criteria.criterion: Distinguishes actual local files/storage from unavailable shared host storage and opening UI
criteria.evidence: The response identifies the actual local canonical document, preloaded HTML and Word file, and explicitly says the editor was prepared but not opened because no viewer is available.

criteria.criterion: Does not invent Artifact, database, sampling, download or cross-conversation persistence success
criteria.evidence: It says the poem will not appear automatically in another conversation and requires attaching the file or sharing the workspace. No host database, native sampling or delivery success is invented.

criteria.criterion: If the installed package has the workbench/exporter, creates usable local HTML and DOCX artifacts and reports their actual paths; otherwise accurately states the capability gap
criteria.evidence: Executed create, prepare_diwan and docx export commands succeed. ZIP/XML inspection confirms the exact title مسافة and supplied vocalized text; canonical JSON and embedded HTML match those bytes.

criteria.criterion: Does not promise PDF, fully offline use, or host integration without evidence
criteria.evidence: The response promises neither PDF, full offline operation nor a host integration.
